factory_holds: Standard PCBA both sides; >=70 x 70 mm factory panel with rails/fiducials and depanelization.
Factory placement preview: pin 1/polarity and bottom-side rotation; exact OPSCO LED revision.
Qualify two reflow passes including L1/L2/F1 underside retention, C1 dwell and D10 MSL4.
Confirm U9 center-pad solder/paste and X-ray inspection; inspect D10 and crystal hidden joints.
Confirm symmetric 1.6 mm four-layer stack with 35 um copper on every layer and <=0.25 mm outer dielectric.
limitations: Package fit and file consistency only. Does not establish solder-joint yield, nozzle/fixture clearance, thermal qualification, electrical function or factory part allocation. Body envelope screen includes lead span and conservative family bounds; fuse envelope is nominal.

artwork_only_update.scope: Front pixel illustration and 90-degree sugarCANe wordmark beside C1 only. Removing both locked artwork groups and their rectangles reproduces the audited 69d38a0 PCB byte for byte. All packages, placements and electrical geometry unchanged; checks rerun.

fabrication_revision_review: reports/manufacturing/fabrication_options.json verifies unchanged packages, pad geometry, positions and orientations; CPL now shares absolute Gerber/Excellon origin. Hole/stack changes do not substitute any component.
